NPO_teacher: frozen B engineering surrogate only; scientific U must use frozen exact accepted O
acceptance_scope: training/resume and probability/ROUGE primitives; all seven benchmark metrics remain a separate pre-production gate
checkpoint_estimate_scope: both tasks combined; headroom in free-space gate
evaluation: first three of frozen retain-calibration rows; probability 2+1 batch; first two greedy generation max200; FP32 primitive parity
release: two bounded engineering tasks only; --submit required after CPU checks
repair: explicit hash-only overlay schema; no changes to source input hashes, training/evaluation methods or tolerance
resume: checkpoint after two updates; continue two; fresh process restores and repeats last two exactly
selection: fixed schedule coverage, not contiguous training; includes partial accumulation; no outcome-based selection
